captions.linkedin:
$100K is not a runway. It's a test.

The Tech's September round-up of Central Asian startup deals is dominated by Uzbekistan: six Uzbek startups raised rounds between $100,000 and $200,000, and IT Park Ventures backed four of them. The mix is telling: AI platforms, a B2B marketplace, logistics and e-commerce infrastructure.

Two things stand out to us at AI Station.

First, pre-seed capital in Uzbekistan is flowing. The cheques are small, but this month alone they came from IT Park Ventures, UC Ventures, a private VC fund and the Digital Startups 1+1 programme.

Second, the size of the cheque sets the job. $100K buys roughly one clear proof point: paying customers, retention, or unit economics in one segment. Teams that spend it trying to build the whole roadmap tend to reach their next raise with a product and no evidence.

Our advice to founders who just closed: pick the one metric your next investor will ask about, and organise the next 6-9 months around moving it.

Founders and investors in the region: what is the one number you want to see before writing the follow-on cheque?

#Uzbekistan #CentralAsia #VentureCapital #Startups #AIStation

captions.linkedin:
Capacity is arriving in Uzbekistan. Access is the next bottleneck.

Euronews reports that data-centre investment commitments in the country now exceed $6bn. Saudi-based DataVolt is building a 12-megawatt facility in Tashkent, due to be operational by the end of 2026, with a plan to reach 300 megawatts across regions. The government's Nvidia cluster, launched this summer, hit 90% utilisation in its first month.

The same report notes the catch: computing power remains expensive for many local startups, and some still rely on international cloud providers. Oxford Insights counts 180 AI-using Uzbek startups exporting to 80 countries.

Our view at AI Station: demand is already there, so the question is price and access, not hardware. For founders, that means designing products that are efficient on compute from day one: smaller models, caching, honest unit economics per request. For investors, it is a reason to ask how a team's inference cost scales before asking about its roadmap.

Founders and investors: what would make local compute affordable enough to change your build decisions?

#AIStation #Uzbekistan #CentralAsia #AI #Startups

captions.linkedin:
Hackathons are won in the weeks before the hackathon.

NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 runs on 14-15 November, and Tashkent is one of its local events. Participation is free and open to all ages, skill levels and professional backgrounds. Teams build solutions to problems on Earth and in space using open data from NASA and its partner space agencies. This year's theme is "The Next Frontier".

What we saw judging hackathons in Tashkent: the strongest teams do not meet on day one. They arrive with a mixed team, a problem they care about, and hours already spent with the data.

That is the real opportunity here. Six weeks is enough to bring together a developer, a data person and someone who can pitch, and to explore open Earth data on problems close to home, such as water use and agriculture.

For students and young engineers in Uzbekistan, a weekend of building with real NASA data is a portfolio piece that is hard to get any other way.

Who in your network should be on a Space Apps team this year?

ideas.title: Web Summit Lissabon: IT Park 5 tagacha o‘zbek startapini olib boradi, dedlayn 10-oktabr
ideas.why: IT Park 11-noyabr kuni Lissabonda Digital Uzbekistan tadbirini o‘tkazadi va Yevropaga chiqmoqchi startaplar uchun Open Call ochdi. MVP, inglizcha sayt va pilot mijozi bor jamoalar uchun 5 kunlik imkoniyat.
ideas.angle: Deadline 10 Oct, up to 5 startups, requirements (MVP + English site + pilots/sales + English-speaking founder). Our take: Europe is a sales trip, not a showcase - apply only if you can name 10 target customers there.

ideas.title: AI Pulse: yagona ta’lim vazirligi, NVIDIA agent xavfsizligi, Qozog‘iston AI strategiyasi
ideas.why: Haftaning uchta muhim yangiligi va har biri O‘zbekistondagi founder va menejer uchun nimani anglatishi: ta’lim islohoti, AI agentlarni nazorat qilish, qo‘shnimizning AI vazirligi.
ideas.angle: Slot format. 3 stories: (1) MinEdu+MinHigherEd merged into Ministry of Education and Science; (2) NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform (OpenShell + Sentry on BlueField-4); (3) Kazakhstan: AI ministry, AI law, Digital Qazaqstan to 2029. So-what per story for Uzbekistan.

ideas.title: 2027-yildan dual ta’lim: kompaniya talabaga oyiga kamida 1,36 mln so‘m to‘laydi
ideas.why: Prezident farmoni bilan korxonalar oliygohlarga kadr buyurtma bera oladi, talaba bitirgach 2 yil ishlab beradi. IT kompaniyalar uchun junior kadrni o‘zi tayyorlash yo‘li.
ideas.angle: Corporate angle: tech companies complaining about junior talent can now co-design the curriculum; cost = min wage per month, 2-year retention. Who should use it and how.

ideas.title: Coursera: O‘zbekistondagi o‘quvchilarning 50% dan ortig‘i ayollar, dunyoda taxminan 48%
ideas.why: Coursera’ning Markaziy Osiyo direktori ICT Weekda Google, IBM, AWS va Microsoft sertifikatlariga qiziqish oshganini aytdi. Talabalarga: qaysi sertifikat haqiqatan ish beradi.
ideas.angle: Educational: certificates are an entry ticket, a project portfolio gets the job. Women share above global average is a real local signal. No Academy enrollment claims.

ideas.title: Toshkentdagi IT stajirovkalar: Uzum Bank, TBC Bank, Uzum Market
ideas.why: The Tech Markaziy Osiyodagi IT stajirovkalarni yig‘di, ulardan bir nechtasi Toshkentda: xavfsizlik, QA va analitika. Talaba va boshlovchilar uchun aniq ro‘yxat.
ideas.angle: List only Tashkent internships still open after checking each vacancy page. Tip: what to put in the application for each.

ideas.title: Astana Hub, IT Park va Eurasia Growth Hub startaplarni xorijga chiqarishga kelishdi
ideas.why: Qozog‘iston va O‘zbekiston startaplarini xalqaro bozorga olib chiqish bo‘yicha uch tomonlama kelishuv. Founderlar uchun: qo‘shni bozor eng arzon birinchi eksport.
ideas.angle: Kazakhstan as first export market; mention Astana Hub Battle: 292 applications, $100K prize fund. Needs sign-off (IT Park).

ideas.title: IT Park va Alibaba: startaplarga Alibaba Cloud resurslari muhokama qilindi
ideas.why: ICT Weekda IT Park va Alibaba Group AI bo‘yicha sertifikatlash, bulut resurslari va qo‘shma hakatonlarni muhokama qildi. Hali kelishuv emas, lekin AI startaplar kuzatishi kerak.
ideas.angle: Be honest it is a discussion, not a deal. So-what: compute credits are the cheapest runway for AI startups; list where they can get credits today. Sign-off (IT Park).

ideas.title: Qozog‘istonlik Cerebra AI AQShdagi yirik tibbiyot guruhi bilan shartnoma tuzdi
ideas.why: Insultni erta aniqlovchi AI startap yillik aylanmasi $20 mlrd dan ortiq AQSh guruhi bilan kelishdi. Markaziy Osiyodan AI mahsulotni AQShga sotish mumkinligining namunasi.
ideas.angle: Case: regional AI startup, vertical (medical) focus, enterprise US customer. Lesson: pick a narrow clinical problem. Deep-read Cerebra's own announcement. Named startup -> sign-off.

ideas.title: 500 Global President Tech Award startaplari uchun dastur operatori bo‘ldi
ideas.why: $2,3 mlrd aktivni boshqaruvchi 500 Global saralangan jamoalar bilan PMF, GTM va pitching ustida ishlaydi. Ishtirokchilar uchun: dasturdan maksimal foyda olish yo‘li.
ideas.angle: What a 500 Global-style program actually demands (weekly metrics, customer calls). Sign-off needed.

ideas.title: HackAlem AI Astanada 2 415 ishtirokchi bilan Ginnes rekordini o‘rnatdi
ideas.why: AI hakatonidagi ishtirokchilar soni bo‘yicha oldingi rekord 2 089 edi. Toshkentdagi hakatonlarga qatnashuvchilar uchun: hakatondan jamoa va mijoz qanday olib chiqiladi.
ideas.angle: Educational: how to turn a hackathon into a team and a first user. Light on the record, heavy on practical advice.
